newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish May CPI seen at one pct, yr/yr below 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polish May CPI seen at one pct, yr/yr below 15 pct.

text.p: Polish consumer prices grew an estimated one percent in May, taking the year-on-year index to below 15.0 percent from 15.3 percent in April, Finance Minister Marek Belka said.
"We estimate that May inflation is about one percent and that forecasts that year-on-year inflation in May will fall below 15 percent are confirmed," Belka told a news conference.
He reiterated that inflation was likely to fall to, or even slightly below the government year-on-year target of 13 percent in December and drop to a single digit in 1998.
